service.ar: تأشيرة استكشاف فرص تأسيس الأعمال 60 يوما

about: Get a single-entry visa to explore setting up a business in the UAE for 60 days, without a UAE host.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Business exploration visa, 60 days. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Entry visa is valid 60 days from issue; enter within that time or it is cancelled
Passport valid for at least 6 months
Financial guarantee is refundable after the visa is cancelled following departure with no residency violations
documents: Initial approval from the relevant authority for establishing a business
Stamped bank statement covering at least 6 months
Bachelor's degree or equivalent recognised qualification
Copy of personal ID for applicants from Afghanistan, Iran or Iraq
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
